description: Engagement lifecycle phase definitions for novahaku persistent engagement mode.

phases.name: init
phases.description: Create engagement workspace and persistent state for a target.
steps: Create engagements/<target>/ directory tree
Write state.json (schema v1.0, phase=init)
Seed findings/findings.csv with the findings_gen.py header

phases.name: recon
phases.description: Consume reconnaissance output and enumerate testable surface.
steps: Read engagements/<target>/recon.json via ReconReader
Extract subdomains, ports, endpoints, tech stack, WAF, origin IP
Record the testable surface into state.json notes
Confirm scope bounds before any active testing

phases.name: race
phases.description: Run candidate testing approaches in parallel and rank them by productivity.
steps: Load approach pool for the observed tech stack
Execute approaches in a bounded thread pool
Score each approach (severity, confidence, reproducibility, impact)
Select one winner approach per vulnerability class
Record race_results into state.json

phases.name: test
phases.description: Deep execution of the winning approaches; emit structured findings.
steps: Run the selected approach per vulnerability class
Filter false positives by evidence pattern
Write findings to findings/findings.json and findings.csv
Update stats counters in state.json

phases.name: exploit
phases.description: Validate confirmed findings into reproducible proof-of-concept evidence.
steps: Re-run each confirmed finding for reproducibility
Capture raw request/response evidence
Mark confidence level (confirmed, likely, possible)
Drop findings that fail to reproduce

phases.name: report
phases.description: Emit the engagement report with severity breakdown and remediation.
steps: Aggregate findings by severity
Render markdown report into engagements/<target>/report.md
Include race results and coverage summary
Emit CSV export for downstream tooling

phases.name: closed
phases.description: Terminal state. Engagement archived, no further active testing.
steps: Freeze state.json (status=closed)
Verify findings references resolve
Optionally archive the engagement directory

approach_pool.description: Built-in testing approaches available to the race phase.

scoring.description: Winner is the approach holding the strongest single piece of evidence. No weighted composite: the previous severity*0.4+confidence*0.3+reproducibility*0.2+impact*0.1 formula used weights with no source, and because it averaged per approach, an approach with 1 CRITICAL beat one with the same CRITICAL plus 5 INFO. Ranking is now ordinal and readable.

gates.description: Only findings at or above this confidence may win. 'possible'/'unlikely' findings are reported but never decide a winner.
